selection_rationale: Contains meaningful but reviewable thermal variation.
Contains post-variation behavior without requiring fabricated recovery.
Has zero internal missing intervals, duplicates, and out-of-order timestamps.
known_limitations: The source environment is a cold storage room, not a pharmaceutical shipment.
The interval does not show clear recovery to baseline.
Source timestamps do not have a verified timezone.
Observed experiment events must not be interpreted as logistics handovers.
Selection does not constitute compliance evaluation.
